A '''diamond shovel''' is a [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]] of the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] tier, crafted from a [[diamond]] and two sticks.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It breaks shovel blocks at speed 9 and has 2500 durability; the cheaper [[golden shovel]] digs faster but lasts a seventh as long.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|5.5}} damage at an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one diamond. It is the base for both [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] upgrades.
